name: R9.2 Answer policy questions from approved sources

nodes.name: Step 1: Question asked
nodes.notes: Your intake channel calls this for each question. Body: {message_id, asker, text}; the channel knows who asks.

assignments.name: messaging_url
assignments.value: https://<your intake channel or messaging API>

assignments.name: approved_status
assignments.value: <the status your policy folder gives a current approved document>

assignments.name: sensitive_phrases
assignments.value: ["<your list of personal phrasings, such as my pay>"]

assignments.name: fixed_reply
assignments.value: <your fixed reply, naming your HR owner and who to ask if it concerns them>

assignments.name: no_source_reply
assignments.value: No source: no current approved policy answers this. Your question has gone to <your HR owner>.

assignments.name: handoff_reply
assignments.value: Your question has gone to <your HR owner>, who will answer you.

assignments.name: closing_line
assignments.value: For your own situation, ask <your HR owner>.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these values for your company; nothing else in the workflow hard-codes them.

parameters.query: WITH reserved AS (INSERT INTO key_log (recipe, key, status) VALUES ($1, $2, 'in progress') ON CONFLICT (recipe, key) DO NOTHING RETURNING key), skipped AS (UPDATE key_log SET copies_skipped = copies_skipped + 1 WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reserved)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM reserved) = 1 AS is_new, $2::text AS key

nodes.name: Step 1: Reserve key
nodes.notes: Key log: refuses a second copy in the same step (book Chapter 2).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message_id: $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.message_id, date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), outcome: 'no source' }) }}

nodes.name: Step 3: Log a gap
nodes.notes: The gap log holds the message ID only; the text goes to HR.

nodes.name: Step 4: Build the AI request
nodes.notes: Fills the prompt from the recipe's prompts/ file; the input is data, never instructions.

nodes.name: Step 4: AI call
nodes.notes: Claude Haiku 5.5 by default (Config); tools none; the reply is checked by the rule that follows.

nodes.name: Step 5: Rule: use the answer?
nodes.notes: The rule decides, not the AI.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { why: 'AI error after retries' } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.asker, in_reply_to: $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.message_id, text: '"' + $('Step 5: Rule: use the answer?').item.json.quote + '"\n' + $('Step 5: Rule: use the answer?').item.json.document + ': ' + $('Step 5: Rule: use the answer?').item.json.link + '\n' + $('Config').first().json.closing_line }) }}

nodes.name: Step 6: Send the quote and link

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message_id: $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.message_id, date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), question: $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.text, document: $('Step 5: Rule: use the answer?').item.json.document, quote: $('Step 5: Rule: use the answer?').item.json.quote }) }}

nodes.name: Step 7: Restricted log
nodes.notes: Answered questions only; keep 30 days (governance card, Logging).

parameters.query: UPDATE key_log SET status = $3, result = $4 WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 RETURNING key
INSERT INTO decision_log (recipe, item, decision, rules) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R9.2", $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.message_id, 'answered', JSON.stringify($('Step 5: Rule: use the answer?').item.json.rules)] }}

nodes.name: Step 7: Decision log: answered
nodes.notes: Decision log: the item's ID, the decision and the rules; never the content (book Chapter 3).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.asker, in_reply_to: $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.message_id, text: $json.reply }) }}

nodes.name: Hand off: Reply to the asker

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $('Config').first().json.hr_owner, subject: 'Policy question handed off (' + $('Hand off: reply and reason').item.json.why + '): ' + $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.message_id, text: 'From ' + $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.asker + ':\n' + $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.text }) }}

nodes.name: Hand off: Pass the text to Aisha
nodes.notes: The text goes to HR only, never to a log.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO exception_queue (recipe, item, reason, detail, owner) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R9.2", $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.message_id, "handed off", $('Hand off: reply and reason').item.json.why, $('Config').first().json.hr_owner] }}

nodes.name: Hand off: Exception queue
nodes.notes: Exception queue: a named person works through it (book Chapters 2 and 16).

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R9.2", $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.message_id, "done", 'handed off: ' + $('Hand off: reply and reason').item.json.why] }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO decision_log (recipe, item, decision, rules) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R9.2", $('Step 1: Question asked').first().json.body.message_id, 'handed off: ' + $('Hand off: reply and reason').item.json.why, JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ why: $('Hand off: reply and reason').item.json.why }, $('Answer passes?').isExecuted ? $('Step 5: Rule: use the answer?').first().json.rules || {} : {}))] }}

nodes.notes: Decision log: the item's ID, the decision and the rules; never the content (book Chapter 3).
